value.name: accepts the confirmation
value.description: Asha closes the laptop on the confirmation screen and sits with her hand on the rate sheet, silently accepting what she has done.
evidence: Asha closed the laptop on the confirmation screen and sat with her hand flat over the rate sheet for a minute longer than she needed to, listening for the part of herself that would have argued against what she had just done and finding it quiet.

value.name: calls Marcus back
value.description: Asha calls Marcus back within the hour she promised and prepares to tell him what she decided.
evidence: Then she picked up the phone and called Marcus back inside the hour she had given him
value.time_hint: inside the hour she had given him

value.name: tells Marcus deposit is wired
value.description: Asha tells Marcus she has wired the full deposit and that his half is now a private matter between them rather than Bridgepoint's concern.
evidence: she said the sentence she had decided on in the kitchen: that she had wired the full deposit, that his half was a number between them now and not a number Bridgepoint was waiting on

value.name: refuses repayment discussion
value.description: Asha refuses to hear any repayment plan from Marcus, believing any plan he offers would be impossible for him to keep.
evidence: and that she did not want to hear a repayment plan today because any plan he offered her in this hour would be one they both knew he could not keep

value.name: hears Claire on the line
value.description: Asha hears Claire breathing during the call but chooses not to invite her into the conversation.
evidence: She heard Claire breathing on the line and did not ask her to speak.

value.name: checks depleted savings
value.description: After hanging up, Asha sees that her savings have dropped to four figures, revealing the cost of her decision.
evidence: When she hung up, the kitchen was the same kitchen, but the savings line on the app behind her had collapsed into four figures she had not seen since her second year at the firm

value.name: faces looming deadlines
value.description: Asha realizes the Monday partners' meeting, Devin's signed page, Whitfield's office, and the Hatcher hearing are now the only things ahead of her.
evidence: and the Monday seven a.m. partners' meeting—Devin's signed page, Whitfield's office, the Hatcher hearing at ten—was suddenly the only thing standing between her and a week in which she had spent every reserve she had built for exactly this kind of emergency

value.name: retrieves corrected page
value.description: Asha picks up the corrected page from the kitchen table where she left it under her keys.
evidence: Asha found the corrected page where she had left it on the kitchen table, weighted under her keys

value.name: confirms Devin's signature
value.description: Asha inspects the page closely and verifies that Devin's signature has set cleanly on the line.
evidence: and she lifted it close enough to confirm Devin's signature had set clean on the line

value.name: receives Rosa's text
value.description: While checking the ink, Asha gets a text from Rosa that begins another consequential message.
evidence: Her phone buzzed on the laminate while she was checking the ink, and Rosa's text was two sentences long
